title: Shop Floor and Warehouse Mobile for Business Central
summary: Shop Floor and Warehouse Mobile is an AL extension for Business Central that enables real-time data capture directly on shop floors and in warehouses through mobile devices with barcode scanning, task-focused pages, and label printing integration. It replaces paper-based workflows and separate systems by consolidating operations, warehouse processing, and time tracking within Business Central itself.
key_points: Real-time barcode scanning and posting eliminate paper travelers, keyboard re-entry delays, and reconciliation overhead

Task-focused mobile pages let operators start/stop operations, post output/consumption, capture downtime, and handle warehouse receipts, picks, counts, and transfers directly from tablets or Android scanners
Label printing integrates with BarTender Cloud for rule-based design and printing to physical label printers from any device without separate infrastructure
Smart barcode system on job cards and labels allows single-scan task execution, preventing errors and reducing manual data entry
Solution is built entirely as an AL extension inside Business Central, extending existing production orders and warehouse documents rather than requiring external WMS or MES systems
features: Task list by device or user
Warehouse receipt, pick, transfer, and count processing

quotes.text: Over the last couple of years, Microsoft made the Business Central mobile app surprisingly capable - barcode scanning, tablet layouts, AL hooks.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the Microsoft capabilities that enabled custom shop floor solutions to be built directly in Business Central

quotes.text: No separate WMS or MES database to integrate and maintain - everything lives in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the key advantage of consolidating warehouse and manufacturing operations in a single system without external tools
